question: A sphere of radius 21 cm is cut into 8 identical pieces by making three mutually perpendicular cuts through its center (one along each axis). Find the total surface area of each piece in cm² .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a sphere of radius r is cut into 8 identical pieces by 3 mutually perpendicular cuts through its center, each piece forms a spherical octant.

Total Surface Area of 1 piece = Curved Surface Area + 3 × Flat Quadrant Areas

Total Area = (1/8 × 4πr²) + 3 × (1/4 × πr²) = 5/4 × πr²

Given r = 21 cm, Area = 5/4 × π × (21)² = 5/4 × 441π

Area = 2205π ÷ 4 = 551.25π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 551.25π cm².**
